description: This file defines the MessageManager class responsible for handling conversation rewind operations, including truncating message history and cleaning up orphaned summaries and markers within a chat application's message management system.

classes.name: MessageManager
classes.description: Provides centralized handling for conversation rewind operations, including message truncation and cleanup.

methods.name: rewindToTimestamp
methods.description: Rewinds conversation to a specific timestamp, the main entry point for message deletion.

methods.name: rewindToIndex
methods.description: Rewinds conversation to a specific message index.

methods.name: performRewind
methods.description: Performs the actual rewind operation, including truncating messages and cleaning up history.

methods.name: collectRemovedContextEventIds
methods.description: Collects condense and truncation IDs from messages to be removed.

methods.name: truncateClineMessages
methods.description: Truncates the message list to a specified index.

methods.name: truncateApiHistoryWithCleanup
methods.description: Truncates API conversation history, removes orphaned summaries and markers, and cleans up tags.
